facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT and Postal Services page says the government has made significant strides in training its officers in modern technologies for the records digitisation effort, which is not yet complete.
The Ministry of ICT and Postal Services lists its Girls in ICT initiative, which gives girls and young women opportunities to gain ICT knowledge and skills, as part of its youth digital programme.
